records.title: A physical theory of decompression sickness
records.locator: Printed p. 221 (PDF p. 246), Fig. 45 and paragraph below it
records.note: Nims's later chapter cites Anthony et al. CAM 136 and reports a 100 °F warm condition, 50 °F cold, 35% and 47% overall, and 34% and 52% in the 23-person repeat comparison. The April 1943 account reports 55 °F and 34.4% and 51% in the repeat subset. Comparable conditions do not establish flight-level linkage. The April exact counts continue to represent the temperature results.
